items.title: John Casimir Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: Faith Morgan. He had some of the rain out on the boat, Faith Morgan.

ctx.x: Who was he on the boat with? Huh? Who was he on the boat with? Who was he on the boat with? Who's man on the boat? I was going to go to Faith Morgan.
Oh yeah. Faith Morgan. He had some of the rain out on the boat, Faith Morgan. I had to make one or two trips on the boat, that's all.
He was gone. He was gone. Gone. And then who did you get on the trumpet?
